notes.title: Deltazone Temporary Development Pause
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to reach out and update you all personally. Due to financial considerations, I've decided to temporarily pause active development and updates on [b]Deltazone[/b] to focus on securing stable employment.

This decision was not easy, as the support and enthusiasm from this community have been incredible. I deeply appreciate all of you who have followed the game's journey, provided valuable feedback, and supported me along the way.

Please understand this is not a goodbye it's just a brief pause. My commitment to Deltazone remains strong, and I look forward to returning to development with renewed energy and resources in the near future.

Thank you all for your understanding, patience, and continued support.

Warm regards,  
[EvolvedPhoenix Studios]

notes.title: Nominate Deltazone for Labor of Love!
notes.content:

Nominate Deltazone for Labor of Love!

Deltazone has been in development since 2020, with the game officially launching on Steam in December 2022. Over the years, the development team has worked tirelessly to refine and expand the game, consistently pushing updates and implementing new features to create the most immersive and enjoyable experience possible. Our goal has always been to build a game that resonates with our community, and we’ve been dedicated to listening to feedback and evolving the game based on player input. notes.title: UPDATE 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.3.0[/h1]

Hey everyone!

Update 0.3.0 is here, and it brings a massive overhaul to the UI, animations, and maps. Every map has been reworked to improve both visuals and gameplay flow, making for a better overall experience. All upcoming maps will follow this updated style, ensuring a consistent and polished feel throughout the game.

Right now, the map selection is smaller as I'm still actively working on them, but my plan is to release a new map every week or two until we reach around 20 maps, each designed with the new improvements in mind.

The animations have also been updated, and while they're still a work in progress, this update is a big step in the right direction. Expect even smoother and more engaging visuals as I continue refining them in future updates.

Thanks for your patience and support as I keep working to make the game better!

notes.title: Important Announcement: End of Active Development and Future Directions
notes.content:
Dear Community Members,

After careful consideration and much deliberation, I have made the difficult decision to discontinue active development on the current game project. While the game will remain available for those who wish to continue enjoying it, please note that it will no longer receive updates or support from this point onward.

I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you for your support and engagement thus far. I am currently exploring new avenues and am optimistic about the potential for an upcoming game release. Should you wish to stay updated on this next endeavor, I invite you to join our Discord server by [url=https://discord.gg/EkUYKmW]clicking here[/url].

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Best regards,

EvolvedPhoenix

notes.title: Information about Deltazone
notes.content:
Hello everyone it has come to my attention that no one really knows some import things about how this game has been being developed. This game started about 10 months ago, it use to be a Star wars fan game, Then it switched to a game called Divided: Online battles, That change happened a couple weeks after I started working on the game. The most important thing of all is that this game is made by a single person (Me EvolvedPhoenix) and I do have a Job as well, so that's the reason why the game may not look as good as you expect or something like that. The game was just a hobby project and still is. I noticed that the game is getting feedback and I understand that there are going to be people that leave negative review and such. But all I ask is for some actual feedback and not random things, for an example someone left a negative review saying " . " and that does give any feedback obviously. Going back to why the game doesn't look amazing, I don't have the Time or Money to make a AAA game. So with all that being said I appreciate everyone that has played so far and left a review. I will still be working on the game to improve it and make it better for everyone. If you have any feedback or anything you can join the [url=https://discord.gg/EkUYKmW]DISCORD[/url] server and tell me it in the Suggestions Channel.

Also some changes are going to happen to the gameplay:
Players will walk and run slower.
Players wont be able to be hop around the map.
Ping limit will be added to servers.
Aim assist will be added.

notes.title: Upcoming Bot Changes
notes.content:
Bots will now nolonger look at players/bots through the wall.
Bot Difficulty is now in working conditions.
==================================================================================

In the furture bots will be able to use killstreaks, Also bots will get better overtime its just a process of learning how the bots should act.

This Update will be out within 1-2 days.

A Pre-Alpha Should also be coming up once i polish a few things and get everything ready.

notes.title: Update 0.0.89.6 Bot support
notes.content:
Bots are now implemented into the game!

When hosting a match you can now select a check mark to enable bots and then set the amount of bots and also the difficulty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42881441/ffab658907b1854e106ee1a35ea2d9686b7cfaed.png[/img]

Bots are still a W.I.P so if you find any bugs let us know about them.
